Eve (AE): Customer NovaHealth needs SIG QnA evidence + a short POC showing KMS/HSM key rotation logs. deadline Fri EOD. Can PS + security pull artifacts? Link: https://redwood.co/sigs/novah
Ashley (Solutions): Yep, I can start Q-by-Q for encryption and key mgmt. Which questions are highest priority? :clock3:
Eve (AE): Q12 (encryption at rest), Q13 (key rotation), Q21 (kms/hsm attestation) are blockers for legal.
Priya (Security): I'll own attestation docs. We have an HSM cert and KMS rotation schedule. Need the rotation logs from infra. Tom, can you pull rotation audit entries for last 90 days? @Tom (Eng)
Tom (Eng): On it. I can grab CloudKMS logs and the HSM audit bundle. ETA 24hrs. I'll paste `gcloud logging` and a small script.
Tom (Eng): ```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_kms_key_ring" AND jsonPayload.eventType="ROTATE"' --limit 1000 > /tmp/kms-rotations.json
``` 
Ben (PS): For the POC, customer wants a short demo: key rotate, show service continues serving without downtime, and show audit entry. I can script a rotate + smoke test.
Eve (AE): Great. Priya, can you map which SIG questions need which artifacts so Ben can attach the right files in the bundle?
Priya (Security): Will do. Quick mapping: Q12 -> encryption config (kms keys, storage settings), Q13 -> rotation policy + schedule PDF, Q21 -> HSM cert + attestation, Q30 -> SOC2 control IDs + evidence pointers. I'll drop a spreadsheet.
Ashley (Solutions): Can we use a sanitized log set for the customer? They asked for non-production copies.
Tom (Eng): Yes — I'll redact PII and host on S3 signed URL. `s3://redwood-sig-evidence/novah/sanitized/kms-rotations.json`
